options.title: Plush Mushroom Hat
sizes: One size (fits a normal sized head)
options.notes: Official merchant page lists current $15.29 (retail $16.99), In Stock, product60308, 11-inch width and felt-foam material. Actual merchant photo inspected: red pointed/domed mushroom cap with white spots, white gathered underside and short white stem/cuff. Pennsylvania-based online party retailer; not a national big-box chain. There is a short white stem/cuff below the cap; it is not identical to the handmade adult cap silhouette.

options.title: Wool Felt Beret With Small Mushroom Hat
options.notes: Red wool felt beret with small raised mushrooms. Beret silhouette differs from the larger domed costume cap; small 3D mushrooms replace allover cream spots. Live public Shopify product feed confirms the exact listed variant available at this USD amount.

options.title: Adult Mushroom Hat — Hat
options.notes: Handmade adult domed cotton mushroom hat with red cap, white spots and pleated cream underside. The $65 hat-only variant is selected, not the $80 hat-and-collar bundle. Live public Shopify product feed confirms the exact listed variant available at this USD amount.

gaps: The medium-price wool beret is an aesthetic variation, not an exact large spotted dome. Choose the low or high option when the full mushroom silhouette is essential.

options.title: The Rosalind Blouse — Cream
options.notes: Cream 100% cotton blouse with drawstring neckline and elastic short puff sleeves. Exact cream variants S–XXL are available in the live merchant feed.

options.title: Marseille Polka Dot Blouse — Cream
options.notes: Cream polyester blouse with long puff sleeves, high mock neck and bow back. Black polka dots add a pattern; it is not plain cream. Live merchant feed shows S/M/L available for $49.00; built-in web search had an older $58.00 price.

options.title: Iona Textured Woven Blouse - Cream
options.notes: Cream textured blouse with tie-neck keyhole and long romantic sleeves. Available live sizes A/B (0–2), C (4–6), D (8–10), E (12–14), F (16–18), G (20–22), I (28–30), J (32–34); H unavailable. Live public Shopify product feed confirms the exact listed variant available at this USD amount.

gaps: The $49 middle option has black polka dots and polyester fabric; it preserves cream color and puff sleeves but is not a plain cotton/linen blouse.

options.title: Classic Brown Corduroy Overalls
options.notes: Live official merchant feed verifies brown corduroy overalls in S only at $55, variant41575476428858. Relaxed wide-leg silhouette with adjustable straps and front bib pocket. Only S is available: do not recommend this item for a different requested size; use the middle XS–XL option instead.

options.title: Brown Cotton Corduroy Overalls - Vintage-Inspired Adjustable Strap C1830 — Brown
options.notes: Brown vintage-inspired cotton corduroy overalls with relaxed fit, adjustable metal-buckle straps, five pockets and cuffed hem. Standard XS–XL are all $89; custom order costs $119 and is excluded from this price tier. Live public Shopify product feed confirms the exact listed variant available at this USD amount.

options.title: Cattail Corduroy Wide Leg Overall — Honey Brown
options.notes: Honey Brown 100% organic cotton mini-corduroy, adjustable straps, relaxed full wide leg. Live feed confirms XS/S/M/L available; XL is unavailable. Price excludes optional promotional codes.

gaps: The $55 budget option has only S remaining. Never substitute an incorrect size to meet budget; the $89 middle option has XS–XL.

Live merchant feed confirms C, D, E, Short F, F, G available; A/B is unavailable. $18.99 is the item amount before any promotional checkout discount; indexed pages advertise variable automatic discounts, which are not assumed.

options.title: Color Tights — Ivory

options.title: Grannies Cable Knit Wool Tights - Oatmeal
options.notes: Oatmeal cable-knit merino wool tights. The oatmeal shade is a deeper cream neutral. Available AB-C/D-E/F/G. Live public Shopify product feed confirms the exact listed variant available at this USD amount.

gaps: Stock Dreams middle option has a separate plus-size listing at the same $28 price (p-de1a3e35c4), not a fourth price tier. A stylist must check fit measurements.
